<thought>We need to locate a retrosynthetic template that converts an aliphatic hydroxyl (C‑O single bond) into an alkyl halide (C‑X single bond). The functional group names are “aliphatic hydroxyls” → “alkyl halide”. To find the template we can search by specifying the bond that is broken (C‑O, atomic numbers 6‑8) and the bond that is formed (C‑Cl, atomic numbers 6‑17). This should return templates for halogenation of alcohols.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles":"CCO","functional_groups_broken":["aliphatic hydroxyls"],"functional_groups_formed":["alkyl halide"],"bonds_broken":["6-8"],"bonds_formed":["6-17"],"limit":5}</action_input>
